ranked.headline: Cell-type-aware methods remove technical structure from single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend cell-type-specific correction to spatial, epigenetic, and sample-level single-cell analyses.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose accuracy limits in long-read RNA modification and isoform calling
ranked.summary: Nanopore and long-read sequencing now yield modification and isoform readouts whose accuracy depends on tool choice and tuned parameters.

ranked.headline: ML models link molecular profiles and structures to drug response and toxicity
ranked.summary: Multi-omics fusion, graph embeddings and foundation models are now applied to treatment failure, drug sensitivity and toxicity prediction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test whether predicted drug and perturbation responses generalize
ranked.summary: Benchmarking and uncertainty analyses now test whether computational predictions of drug and perturbation response generalize beyond training data.

ranked.headline: Cell imaging models shift from manual annotation to synthetic and foundation routes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications from December 2025 pair cell-imaging deep learning with synthetic data, unsupervised, and foundation-model training.

ranked.headline: Single-cell methods assign regulatory effects and disease links to specific cell types
ranked.summary: Scalable single-cell eQTL and risk-transfer methods are moving regulatory and disease inference to cell-type resolution.

ranked.headline: Computational models link RBP binding and splicing to chromatin and NMD in tumors
ranked.summary: Single-cell and bulk tumor RNA-seq now enable computational inference of splicing regulation tied to chromatin state.

ranked.headline: Cheap embeddings and data-centric methods compete with large biological language models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether training-free sketches, pruning, and task-specific learning can replace costly adaptation of pretrained biological models.

ranked.headline: Multiscale models learn neural representations across fMRI, iEEG, LFP, and spike data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair transformer foundation models and switching dynamical models with multiscale spike, LFP, and intracranial recordings.

ranked.headline: Free-energy and learned potentials score, sample, and simulate biomolecular structures
ranked.summary: Automated free-energy pipelines and learned energy models now extend to membrane proteins, RNA folding, and CRISPR-Cas9 activity.

ranked.headline: Pretrained foundation models are being adapted across pathology and omics tasks
ranked.summary: Multimodal pathology foundation models and cloud pipelines now target slide-level and single-cell inference from H&E images.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level genomes tie architecture change to transposons and population size
ranked.summary: Recent chromosome-level assemblies across diverse taxa now permit mechanistic attribution of genome size, structural variation and nuclear organisation.

ranked.headline: Learned models couple histology and spatial profiles to predict tissue molecular state
ranked.summary: Histology-based foundation models and spatial graph methods now predict spatial molecular state across tissues, from pathway activity to cell-cell networks.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale metabolic models reveal lineage-specific bacterial metabolic capacity
ranked.summary: Mechanistic metabolic models are now paired with transcriptomics, flux analysis, and comparative genomics across large bacterial genome sets.

ranked.headline: Variant and spike studies probe immune evasion and viral glycoprotein dynamics
ranked.summary: KP.3.1.1 became a dominant JN.1 successor by late 2024, prompting study of its pathogenicity and immune evasion.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings drive ion channel and glycation site prediction
ranked.summary: Recent items reuse protein language model representations for narrow prediction tasks, alongside graph-based representation learning for disease associations.

ranked.headline: Omics features are being linked across metabolites, genes and drug exposures
ranked.summary: Untargeted metabolomics drug-exposure libraries and agentic LLM pipelines are automating how omics features reach statistical and biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: Structure-based tools mine conserved features in interfaces, glycans and lysins
ranked.summary: Structure-aware software now extends conserved-feature mining from protein interfaces to glycans and metagenomic phage lysins.

ranked.headline: Neoantigen prioritization tools couple antigen quality, HLA context and off-target risk
ranked.summary: Sequencing-based neoantigen pipelines are moving toward patient outcome prediction and population-aware off-target safety assessment.

ranked.headline: In silico screen nominates ZNF654 and JMJD6 as 3D genome boundary factors
ranked.summary: In silico screening and cross-genome sequence analysis now infer chromosome-level organisation and chromatin responses directly from sequence data.

ranked.headline: Residue-level side-chain flexibility and interaction decomposition in ligand binding
ranked.summary: Structure-based analysis is moving from static docking poses toward residue-resolved, mechanistic accounts of protein-ligand recognition.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale sequence representations resolve bacterial identity, lineage, and function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply k-mer sketching, long-read sequencing, and ML benchmarking to bacterial genome interpretation.

ranked.headline: Non-additive and interaction models are reshaping genetic association analysis
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale data now permit direct testing of epistasis, dominance, and co-regulation rather than marginal single-variant effects.

ranked.headline: Open-source Python and R tools standardize QC, benchmarking, and genomic interval analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published viewer package spatial QC, proteomics benchmarking, and interval operations into open, reusable software with defined…

ranked.headline: Benchmarks weigh accuracy, scalability and inference across omics analysis methods
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test omics pipelines against known differences and explicit criteria across single-cell, metaproteomic and spatial data.

ranked.headline: Computational recovery of structure from noisy or penetrating imaging data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method apply computational reconstruction to live-cell, cryo-EM, and intact hydrated-cell X-ray imaging.

ranked.headline: Reduced-resolution models link chromosome folding and epithelial geometry to mechanics
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained polymer and vertex models now couple mechanical and in vivo constraints to chromosome folding and tissue geometry.

ranked.headline: Enhanced-sampling simulations predict GPCR activation and drug residence times
ranked.summary: Automated enhanced-sampling protocols are extending free-energy predictions to GPCR activation states and absolute drug residence times.

ranked.headline: Compartmental and inverse models infer transmission under sparse or limited data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply ODE, Petri net, and inverse methods to vector control and outbreaks where case data are sparse or spatially fragmented.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and mixed models sharpen inference from population genetic data
ranked.summary: ARG-based mixed models and genotyping-by-sequencing simulators address scalability demands in population-scale genomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Diffusion and fine-tuning methods expand controllable protein and molecule design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend generative design to sampling temperature, protein language model fine-tuning, and non-canonical amino acid diffusion.

ranked.headline: PDE and reduction models expose how structured interactions shape population dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints combine PDE models and singular perturbation reduction with explicit spatial structure in microbial and cellular systems.

ranked.headline: Computational models link metabolite, gene, and serum omics signatures to physiology
ranked.summary: Multi-omics data and genome-scale models are increasingly paired with machine learning to link molecular profiles to phenotypes.

ranked.headline: Computational tools score gene sets, isoforms, and regulatory elements across omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints convert transcriptomic, chromatin, and spatial measurements into scored, benchmarked, comparable outputs.

ranked.headline: Indexing and sketching structures for pangenome, ancient DNA, and long-read alignment
ranked.summary: Pangenome graphs, ancient DNA, and long reads are driving new indexing, compression, and sketching designs for sequence data.

ranked.headline: Learned surrogates model metabolic, chemical, and gene regulatory dynamics
ranked.summary: Neural and reinforcement learning models now fit or plan over pathway, reaction-network, and single-cell dynamics in place of direct simulation.

ranked.headline: Calibration and interpretable models refine variant and methylation measurements
ranked.summary: Recent work addresses platform-specific artifacts in arrays, imputation, and tumour-only calls with explicit calibration and interpretable models.

ranked.headline: Sparse E/I network spectra and LSD-induced synchrony constrain neural dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and published work ties spectral stability and E/I balance to constraints on large-scale neural dynamics.

ranked.headline: Open tools standardize, multimodally align, and inspect omics low-dimensional embeddings
ranked.summary: Standardized autoencoder pipelines, text-aligned contrastive models, and interactive viewers now link omics embedding training with subset inspection.

ranked.headline: Predictor reliability limits on disordered, amyloid, and de novo designed proteins
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now probe where AlphaFold3 and peer predictors fail, including multimer, amyloid polymorph, nanobody-ligand, and design refolding settings.
